_comment: Decrypted protocol v2 messages of nine flows, captured from the official mostrod v0.19.2 binary on an isolated regtest network on 2026-10-04. Node A has no bond; node B asks both sides for a 3 % bond and a first-contact proof of work of 8 bits. Messages are in the order the relay received them; `at` is the event created_at in seconds since the first message of the flow, so equal values are real same-second ties. Parties are named by their side of the order; a second or third taker is buyer2, buyer3. The admin is the node key. All keys are throwaway and the invoices are regtest ones.
